title: Mémoire sur les nombres premiers
abstract: A Lean 4 proof, with no unproved steps and no hypotheses, of explicit two-sided bounds for Chebyshev's function psi from P. L. Chebyshev, Mémoire sur les nombres premiers, 1852, with Chebyshev's constant A = log 2/2 + log 3/3 + log 5/5 - log 30/30 = 0.92129.... For every natural number n at least 30, psi of n is at least A n - 5 log n + 2 log 30 - 1; for every natural number n, psi of n is at most 6A/5 n + 2 log^2 n + 160. The proof uses Chebyshev's combination of log n!, log of the factorials of n/2, n/3 and n/5, and log of the factorial of n/30, as in the paper, with error terms weaker than Chebyshev's. Mathlib has Chebyshev type bounds only with the constants log 2 and log 4. The Lean code was written by an AI agent and is offered for human audit. Goldbach's conjecture is open and is not claimed.
